label: a_sch_ground01_eve01
text: It’s great that the schoolyard’s so big! Even huge\nPokémon have plenty of space to come out!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve02
text: If you stare at Gyarados’s face, it might lower\nyour Attack with Intimidate!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve22
text: I heard that Tropius loves fruit so much it started\ngrowing fruit on its neck!\c\nThat can’t be true, right?!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve24
text: The dishes at the cafeteria all use ingredients\ngrown here!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve25
text: Whether with Pokémon or with gardening, you\nend up asking yourself: What should I raise next?

label: a_sch_ground01_eve26
text: Cyclizar is so glossy and cute! It really helps take\nthe stress of studying away.

label: a_sch_ground01_eve27
text: I’ve started a Cyclizar therapy service. Stare at it\nfor as long as you’d like!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve29
text: I was just running with Mudbray—its stamina is\nsomething else!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve49
text: I’m about to have a Pokémon battle with my\nfriend!

label: a_sch_ground01_eve50
text: Friends know each other’s tricks! When we battle,\nit’s all about anticipating one another’s strategy!

label: a_sch_ground01_ni03
text: I couldn’t sleep, so I thought I’d take a walk\naround the school.

label: a_sch_ground01_ni05
text:
I saw Nemona win 30 Pokémon battles in a row
here at the schoolyard the other day!\c
She definitely deserves that Champion Rank
of hers!

label: a_sch_ground01_ni06
text: Nemona’s the student council president, and a\nChampion, and has top-notch grades...\c\nIs there anything she can’t do?

label: a_sch_ground01_ni09
text: I’m just picturing what it’d be like to battle on\na court so that I don’t get nervous at Gyms!

label: a_sch_ground01_ni16
text: It took a lot of effort to get Magikarp to evolve\ninto Gyarados, let me tell you...

label: a_sch_ground01_ni21
text: Gengar smiles even while it’s sleeping. Isn’t that\njust the most adorable thing ever?

label: a_sch_ground01_ni22
text: I’ve seen a student with a weird hairdo come out\nof the director’s office now and then...
